thread:
alex: Publishing the postmortem for the partial-degradation incident this morning. Internal doc: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.com/pm/1839009999 (internal only).
postmortem-bot: Postmortem uploaded. Timeline, impact, and mitigations sections filled. Auto-summary added. :robot_face:
marta: TL;DR for folks skimming: a config drift in the routing rules caused a small subset of traffic to hit a legacy pool without the new caching layout; symptoms were increased tail latency and ~18 minutes of 5xxs for some tenants. No data exfiltration.
cto-anya: Thanks. Please add an executive summary + single-slide action list for the board.
alex: Done. Copying immediate action items here — owners, short ETAs. Please ACK and update directly in the doc.
```
- A1 | Owner: alex    | Reconcile routing config sources; add an automated diff check between repo and runtime | Due: 2026-03-29
- A2 | Owner: marta   | Add pre-deploy compatibility validation for pool cache layout | Due: 2026-03-30
- A3 | Owner: sre     | Configure pool-version mismatch alert and paging; add playbook link | Due: 2026-03-28
- A4 | Owner: docs    | Update onboarding + ops runbook to include compatibility checklist | Due: 2026-04-03
- CHECKPOINT | All owners | Post a brief status update in the doc before EOD 2026-03-27
```
sre: Will add the alert and paging rule this afternoon. Will test in staging and tag oncall when enabled.
marta: Ill prototype the compatibility validator as a preflight job. PR will reference the RCA.
docs: Ill add the checklist entry and a short example in the ops runbook. ETA EOW.
alex: I reverted the live routing change to stop the misrouting while we push fixes. Rolling patched config to canary now.
postmortem-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled: 2026-04-08 11:00 PT. Invite sent. :calendar:
cto-anya: Good containment. Keep CS looped for any customers that ask; we should be proactive for tenants that reported errors.
marta: Will attach results of local preflight runs to the doc once available.
alex: Thanks everyone. If you cant make the follow-up meeting, leave a short status in the doc. Treat the April 8 meeting as the closure checkpoint for this RCA. :white_check_mark:
